Leaflet 1.9.4 — vendored from the npm package (leaflet@1.9.4).
Files: leaflet.js, leaflet.css, images/ (production build, dist/).
Upstream: https://leafletjs.com  •  License: BSD-2-Clause (see LICENSE.txt).
Map tiles are loaded at runtime from the OpenStreetMap tile servers and are
NOT vendored; their use is subject to the OSM tile usage policy.
